name: Achilles
author: Addicting Games
description: Achilles is a free fighting game. Achilles is a side-scrolling platformer that lets you live out your dreams of ancient Greece and all the drama, comedy and tragedy that follows. Play as Achilles, the fleet-footed soldier who is tasked with holding back legions of approaching troops and mythological monsters. You won't have much more than a sword, your shield, and your wits to save you in this furious but fun Flash game. Guard your neck and don't spare weak. You'll have to be outright ruthless if you want to live up to the namesake of one of histories greatest warriors. Just remember, its all fun and games until someone strikes your heel! Be brave and be victorious!
